description: Search government transparency laws across five domains: open records, open meetings, fiscal transparency, digital accessibility, and oversight bodies. Filter by country, pillar, and/or a substring of the law name, citation, or jurisdiction. Returns compact records with jurisdiction slugs; use get_open_records_law for full open-records detail.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

query.description: Substring to match against law name, citation, or jurisdiction (case-insensitive)
